subject: AWS Marketplace listing: SKU usage phrasing, SLA language, and co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Fields <acme-pm@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing: SKU usage phrasing, SLA language, and co-sell readiness

Hi team (and Jordan),

Attached is our first-pass draft for the AWS Marketplace product page and SKU mapping for the Acme Cloud Analytics integration. High-level asks: please review usage-tier language, SLA/uptime phrasing, and the co-sell bullets we plan to include for the AWS field. I want to ensure we have procurement-friendly snippets and that the phrasing maps cleanly to the meter we intend to surface in the listing.

Quick notes: 
- One-liner we propose for the hero: “Low-latency, cost-optimized LLM inference for analytics pipelines.” (open to edits)
- Usage tiers: monthly token-equivalent tiers (Starter / Growth / Enterprise) — we need language that avoids implying specific throughput guarantees while still being clear about entitlements.
- SLA blurb: keep to a single sentence: “SLA available for Dedicated deployments; contact sales for region-specific SLAs.” Don’t promise hosted uptime numbers on the public listing.
- Co-sell bullets (for AWS field): list partner validation, joint demo assets, and a suggested intro script. See draft section “Co-sell enablement” in the attachment.

Jordan — can you confirm whether Acme needs phrasing that references per-seat vs per-ingestion billing? Procurement asked about that in the onboarding call; I want to align the listing to the commercial terms you expect.

Please reply with inline edits or approve by EOD Monday so we can finalize assets for the marketplace upload.

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_listing_draft_v3.docx] [Attachment: sku-mapping.csv]

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Listings & GTM, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Jordan Fields <acme-pm@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: SKU usage phrasing, SLA language, and co-sell readiness

On Fri, Mar 29, 2029 at 09:12, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi team (and Jordan),
> 
> Attached is our first-pass draft for the AWS Marketplace product page and SKU mapping for the Acme Cloud Analytics integration. High-level asks: please review usage-tier language, SLA/uptime phrasing, and the co-sell bullets we plan to include for the AWS field. I want to ensure we have procurement-friendly snippets and that the phrasing maps cleanly to the meter we intend to surface in the listing.

Thanks Irene — quick pass from content/field perspective below. I made inline suggestions in the doc (see acme_listing_draft_v3.docx) but summary here: 

1) Hero one-liner: prefer explicit benefit + target workload: 
   "Real-time LLM inference for analytics: sub-second insights, predictable unit economics."
   Rationale: frames latency + cost which are top objections for infra buyers.

2) Usage phrasing: avoid naming tokens in the public blurb; use example scenarios instead. Example copy: 
   "Starter (up to 2M inference units/month) — ideal for proofs of concept and small teams."
   Use the term "inference units" in copy and save token-equivalent math for the SKU footnote / SKU mapping CSV.

3) SLA language: fully agree — public listing should say: 
   "Enterprise SLA available with Dedicated or Private deployments; contact sales for details."
   Add a quick footnote link to our SLA pdf in the evidence binder (links in related_links).

4) Co-sell bullets: tighten to three: 
   - Joint field demo (30-min starter kit)
   - AWS solutions brief + architecture diagram
   - Sales intro template for AWS sellers

Action items I propose: Kim to confirm final hero and co-sell bullets; Jonas to validate SKU mapping aligns with billing team; I’ll update the product page copy and push a v4 doc.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplace Content & Enablement, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[Attachment referenced: acme_listing_draft_v3.docx]

From: Jordan Fields <acme-pm@acmecloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Mar 2029 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: SKU usage phrasing, SLA language, and co-sell readiness

Thanks Irene & Marissa — this looks good. A couple of procurement/ops questions from our side: 

1) Billing meter: Acme prefers a per-ingestion meter (events processed) with optional monthly committed tiers. Will Redwood be able to expose both "inference units" and a per-ingestion meter in the private offer? We need the listing to not preclude the per-ingestion contract we expect to sign.

2) Evidence for co-sell: can you attach the joint architecture diagram and a short architecture note (1-2 pages) we can share with our AWS account team? That helps AWS sellers quickly map triggers and deployment patterns.

3) Procurement flagged the need for a sample Private Offer doc or sample term sheet to confirm SLA request/penalty language — even a redlineable example is fine.

If you can share the architecture diagram and a short meter mapping table this afternoon, procurement will be able to confirm whether the listing language is compatible with our PO.

—Jordan
Jordan Fields
Partnerships Lead, Acme Cloud Analytics
jordan.fields@acmecloud.com

----

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Fields <acme-pm@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Mar 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: SKU usage phrasing, SLA language, and co-sell readiness

Jordan — thanks for the clarity. Summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth before we upload: 

Decisions: 
- Public listing will use "inference units" in high-level copy and example scenario tiers. We will not publish token math on the listing page. 
- We will support a per-ingestion meter in the Private Offer/PO flow; SKU mapping will include a per-ingestion conversion column so finance can generate compliant POs.
- SLA sentence on public listing: "Enterprise SLA available with Dedicated or Private deployments; contact sales for details." Any SLA penalties will be handled in the Private Offer/contract, not the public copy.

Deliverables & owners: 
- Marissa: push v4 of the marketplace copy (hero + co-sell bullets) by Mon 9am PT.
- Jonas: review sku-mapping.csv and add the per-ingestion conversion column for Acme by Mon 12pm PT.
- Kim: attach the 1-page architecture note and the joint architecture diagram to the evidence binder link (see related_links) by Mon EOD.
- Irene (me): prepare a sample PO term-sheet/redline template and upload to HubSpot/drive for Jordan & procurement to review by Tue EOD.

Jordan/procurement — we’ll reply in HubSpot (HubSpot-Deal-67890) with the updated artifacts and a short summary so you can escalate to your AWS account team. If anything here contradicts your procurement constraints, please flag and I’ll loop legal.

Thanks all — aiming to close the copy and artifacts Monday so we can start the AWS listing upload Tuesday.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partner Listings & GTM, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
